skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Quiet Move
skins.content: Test Collection Series/Quiet Move. A master move made by Zuo Le. He has played his own shadow across boards and grids. Over time, he learned that while the patterns are many, the wisdom behind them is one.
skins.usage: One of Zuo Le's casual outfits.
skins.quote: A humble piece on the board, his path diverged from all others. Adversity hardened him, gifted him growth; at the decisive moment, he would break the deadlock.

skins.name: Youthful Journey
skins.content: 0011 New Arrivals/Youthful Journey. Outfit Zuo Le wore when using the Tianshi Bureaus' training grounds. Integrated with elements of the Tianshi gown, enabling mobility while highlighting his youthful spirit.
skins.usage: One of Zuo Le's casual outfits.
skins.quote: A chivalrous young swordsman has come to the Tianshi Bureaus. It is said he traversed the lands and learned much on his travels, but to hear a story from him, you must first duel him. Learning of this, the young Tianshis rolled up their sleeves, thinking of asking him for 'guidance'.
